title: Single-tracking at Clocktower Row
body: Trains share the southbound platform evenings this week while track maintenance continues. Allow 4-6 extra minutes between Clocktower Row and Central Market.

title: Holiday service hours
body: All lines run a Sunday schedule on public holidays. The trip planner already reflects reduced frequencies.

title: Detour via Stonebridge
body: Water-main work closes Riverbend Avenue. Purple Line buses detour via Stonebridge, skipping Riverbend in both directions until further notice.

title: Tram speed restrictions
body: Green Line trams run at reduced speed across the Old Mill bridge. Add 3-4 minutes to Cathedral Green trips.

title: New shelter at Eastbrook
body: A covered waiting shelter with real-time display is now open on the eastbound platform at Eastbrook.
